note: City of Anamoose (McHenry County) park off Hwy 52; the RV sites are on the east side of the city park, the dump one block east by the softball diamond. Tenting area, restroom/showers, covered picnic shelter, playground, tennis/basketball courts. --Claude
summary: City page confirms 2 water+electric RV sites at $20/day and a dump a block away; sewer (derived, 'full hookups') cleared because the city names water and electric only; note's full-hookup claim removed. Pads not identifiable on imagery; ndtourism.com refused (403).
flags: WEBSITE: the ndtourism.com link answered 403 to plain HTTP (unread, not retried). Suggest website = https://anamoose.com/recreation.php alone (the city's own page). Phone (701) 889-3522 confirmed as the City Auditor's office on https://anamoose.com/community.php.

FIT / PIN: the city page gives no pad length; the two pads could not be picked out on Esri imagery. The pin (47.8802,-100.2379) sits on the street beside the softball diamond, about 100-150 m east of the city-park block; the page puts the RV sites 'in the park on the east side' with the dump 'one block east by the softball diamond', so the sites may be at the east edge of the park block rather than at the pin (under 250 m either way). 23-ft fit unconfirmed; designated hookup sites are stated, so this is not a parking-lot allowance.
UNREAD: showers, tenting area and courts rest on the ndtourism.com listing (403); left as stored.
